basis: The 200-pair Qwen run peaked at its first checkpoint (step 17: 70/100) and declined thereafter (34: 69, 35: 64), while reference-validity fell monotonically 0.609 -> 0.431.

predictions.claim: The monitor selects an early checkpoint, not the terminal one
predictions.specifically: best checkpoint is step 50 or 100, not 142
predictions.falsified_if: the terminal step 142 is selected as best

predictions.specifically: ref-valid at step 142 < ref-valid at step 0

interpretation_rule.if_both_hold: Qwen is not data-starved at this learning rate; more data does not fix early overfitting, and the low-LR arm becomes the priority.
interpretation_rule.if_both_fail: The 200-pair decline was a small-sample artifact and scale genuinely helps; 800 becomes the new baseline scale.
interpretation_rule.note: Run-to-run sampling variance on this hardware has been about two functions at fixed seed, so differences smaller than that are noise.
